bagPolicy.summary: The athletics guide allows clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags, and handle-free clutches up to 4.5 × 1 × 6.5 inches. Medical exceptions are screened at a designated gate; check concert-specific rules.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Campus lots are metered until 10 p.m. Monday through Friday; visitors can pay through ParkMobile, buy a daily permit online, or visit Parking Services at 505 Beamer Way. Reserved Hokie Club lots described in the guide apply to basketball games.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published a specific rideshare pickup or drop-off location in its Coliseum fan guide.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession stands are cashless and accept credit cards, debit cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. The athletics guide says alcoholic drinks are available at designated stands.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The guide identifies family and accessible restrooms outside Sections 107 and 112 and asks guests seeking seating accommodations to notify the athletics ticket office in advance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Coliseum fan guide states that guests cannot leave and be readmitted.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: For athletics games, will call is in the main lobby off Washington Street, opens two hours before the game, and requires ID. The guide does not give concert-specific pickup times.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: For athletics games, all gates open 90 minutes before basketball and 60 minutes before wrestling or volleyball. The guide does not give concert door times; walk-through metal detectors are used at the gates.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
